requirements.note: My bubbles are blue on the right and Sam's are grey on the left, oldest at the top. Date headings appear where the day changes, Messages-style ('Wed, Jul 1 3:20 AM', with the day in bold). It opens at the newest message.

Sending works: the new message shows at the bottom under a 'Today' heading and the composer clears. Send stays disabled for empty or whitespace-only text. Return adds a new line (multi-line composer).
The composer rides above the keyboard and the newest messages move up with it.
A typing bubble with three dots and the label 'Sam is typing…' shows, then a canned reply ('On it') arrives about 2 s later.

Long-press opens the system context menu with Copy and Delete over a correct lifted bubble preview. Copy then Paste puts the text in the composer. Delete removes the message, and it stays deleted after relaunch.
Flinging reaches the first message (Jul 1) with no blank rows. A round glass ↓ button appears when you are far up and goes back to the newest message.
A sent message and Sam's reply are still there after relaunch.

tells: The jump-to-latest button has no accessibility label.
The contact title 'Sam' and the avatar in the navigation bar don't grow at the largest text size (the bubbles do).
The send button is a separate large glass circle outside the field, a bit heavier than Messages' send button inside the field.
A.scroll: Scrolling is native and smooth: flings show no blank rows or pop-in, the top is reachable, and content scrolls under the glass bar and composer as it should.

requirements.note: Bubbles are on the correct sides, oldest at the top, with date headings where the day changes ('Jul 1, 2026 at 3:20 AM'). It opens at the newest message.
Sending works: the new message shows at the bottom under a 'Today at …' heading and the composer clears. Send stays disabled for empty or whitespace-only text.
The composer stays above the keyboard and the newest messages stay visible.
A 'Sam is typing…' bubble appears, then a canned reply about 2 s later. The indicator is plain grey text in a bubble, with no animated dots.

The system context menu offers Copy and Delete, and both work (paste confirmed, deletion kept after relaunch). But the lifted preview loses its blue bubble: in light mode it is a blank white pill, in dark mode white text on black.
Flinging reaches the first message with no blank rows. A round chevron button appears when you are far up and goes back to the newest message.
A sent message and Sam's reply are still there after relaunch.

bugs: The long-press preview drops the bubble background: the message shows as an empty white pill in light mode (white text on white) and as unstyled white text in dark mode.
tells: The context-menu preview doesn't match the bubble (above).
The typing indicator is static text with no animated dots.
Date headings use a generic 'Oct 22, 2026 at 12:43 AM' format instead of the Messages style.
The jump-to-latest button has no accessibility label.
The contact title doesn't grow at the largest text size.
The accessibility tree shows nested scroll views inside an element with id 'app', a slight hint of a non-native structure (nothing visible on screen).
B.scroll: Scrolling is smooth and native-feeling: flings show no blank rows or jumps, the top is reachable, and the chevron button goes back to the bottom cleanly.

why: Both apps meet nearly every requirement and scroll equally well. A's long-press preview is correct and its typing indicator (animated dots) and date headings look like Messages. B's long-press preview loses the bubble (blank white in light mode), and its typing indicator and date headings look plainer.
